import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    # Fix island label variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Fix body_mass_g: commas and text-to-number
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix magnitude errors (e.g., 3650000 -> 3650)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 10000
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Enforce valid range; invalid become NaN
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    # Ensure other numeric columns are numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['bill_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bill_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['bill_depth_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bill_depth_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    return df

def answer(df):
    sub = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = sub.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in means.items()}
